newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products steady to softer and slow.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products steady to softer and slow.

text.p: Med oil products were steady to softer on Tuesday.

Gasoline was steady to soft. Traders said nearby supply was still fairly tight and some demand was being seen for low and medium octane material from North Africa and the East Med, but this was fairly relaxed.
Eurograde cargoes valued around $217.50 a tonne cif Med.
Naphtha prices were little changed. Egyptian barrels were offered around $223 a tonne cif Med.
High sulphur fuel oil markets were also becalmed. A trader was heard to be bidding numbers at least three dollars above swaps levels for a bunker commitment into Italy.
Isab-quality barrels were also heard on offer from a trader at around $92 fob Med.
Low sulphur fuel oil was around a dollar weaker, but buying interest remained very thin.
The gas oil market was very quiet with mild temperatures and industry functions in London drawing away liquidity.
Russian material was assessed around high cif quotes flat to 50 cents down while FOD should be able to attract fob high quote +$1
